title: Near-Optimal Decentralized Stochastic Convex Optimization over Networks
abstract: arXiv:2606.04757v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We study decentralized stochastic smooth convex optimization, where $M$ workers minimize an average objective using local stochastic gradients and neighbor-only communication over a fixed gossip network. A central question in this setting is to determine the largest number of workers that can be used under a total budget of $N$ gradient samples while still preserving the centralized $O(1/\sqrt N)$ statistical rate. We introduce an accelerated decentralized method that preserves this rate for up to $\smash{M\lesssim \sqrt{\rho}\,N^{3/4}}$ workers, where $\rho$ is the spectral gap of the gossip network, improving the best prior maximal scaling of $\smash{M\lesssim \rho\sqrt N}$. The method is based on a one-step-delayed stochastic acceleration scheme that enables workers to interleave minibatching with accelerated gossip while controlling residual disagreement, and its guarantee depends only logarithmically on the optimum-local h

translated_title: 网络上近最优的去中心化随机凸优化
translated_abstract: 本文研究去中心化随机光滑凸优化问题，其中 $M$ 个工作者在固定的gossip通信网络上，利用本地随机梯度并仅与邻居通信，共同最小化一个平均目标函数。该设定下的一个核心问题是：在总共 $N$ 个梯度样本的预算下，确定在仍能保持中心化 $O(1/\sqrt N)$ 统计速率的前提下，可使用的最大工作者数量。我们提出了一种加速去中心化方法，当工作者数量多达 $M\lesssim \sqrt{\rho}\,N^{3/4}$ 时仍能保持该速率，其中 $\rho$ 为gossip网络的谱隙，这改进了此前最优的 $M\lesssim \rho\sqrt N$ 的最大可扩展规模。该方法基于一种单步延迟的随机加速方案，使工作者能够在小批量（minibatch）计算与加速gossip通信之间交替进行，同时控制剩余的分歧，其理论保证仅对最优值-局部……（原文截断）呈对数依赖。
tldr: 提出一种基于单步延迟随机加速机制的去中心化优化方法，将保持中心化 $O(1/\sqrt N)$ 统计速率的最大工作者数量从原有的 $\rho\sqrt N$ 提升至 $\sqrt{\rho}\,N^{3/4}$，达到近最优的规模扩展。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a one-step-delayed stochastic acceleration scheme for decentralized stochastic convex optimization, raising the maximal number of workers that preserve the centralized $O(1/\sqrt N)$ statistical rate from $\rho\sqrt N$ to $\sqrt{\rho}\,N^{3/4}$, achieving near-optimal scaling.
